facts.fact: The digital ministry's communications officer told La Nation that the electronic mail-management platform (Gec) had been deployed in several communes, naming Porto-Novo, Cotonou and Parakou with no count, and that unreliable internet connections and unsuitable equipment still hold it back; the article does not say whether the offices using it are the communes' own or how they are connected, and gives no date, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: Connection used for the Gec platform in the communes

systems.country_label: plateforme de gestion électronique des courriers (Gec)
systems.owner: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation
systems.tiers: public administration; deployed in several communes such as Porto-Novo, Cotonou and Parakou

note: The one fact rests on an ambiguous sentence: 'deployed in several communes' may mean state offices located there rather than the town halls.
